searchText: I left some comments I would also strongly suggest to ship PAY. This is a super helpful DevEx tool and I honestly think it should be a no-brainer to add this (either with or without EOF) Without PAY if you want to send ETH you are forced to execute code (if it exists) on the target account. Which is not nice. And it also wastes gas
